query: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[sup:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product) WHERE sup.isPrimary = true WITH MAX(sup.leadTimeDays) AS maxLeadTime MATCH (p2:Product)<-[sup2:SUPPLIES]-(s2:Supplier) WHERE sup2.isPrimary = true AND sup2.leadTimeDays = maxLeadTime WITH p2 MATCH (c:Customer)<-[:PLACED_BY]-(:Transaction)-[:CONTAINS_PRODUCT]->(p2) RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT c) AS customerCount
